title: get apihealth returns servicestatus
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with correct service status and uptime details when the service is running.

title: post apiauthregister creates new tenant and superadmin
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register with valid company and admin details creates a new tenant and root super admin, returning HTTP 201.

title: post apiauthlogin authenticates user and returns jwt
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid identifier and password returns HTTP 200 with a JWT token.

title: get apiauthme returns authenticated user profile
description: Verify that GET /api/auth/me with valid bearer token returns HTTP 200 with user profile and company metadata.

title: get apiemployees lists employees for tenant
description: Verify that GET /api/employees with valid JWT returns HTTP 200 with the list of employees for the authenticated tenant.

title: post apiemployees creates new employee record
description: Verify that POST /api/employees with required fields creates a new employee and returns HTTP 201 with the employee record.

title: get apiemployeesid returns deep employee profile dossier
description: Verify that GET /api/employees/:id with valid employee ID and JWT returns HTTP 200 with detailed employee profile dossier.

title: get apiemployeesidsalary returns statutory salary breakdown
description: Verify that GET /api/employees/:id/salary with authorized role returns HTTP 200 with statutory CTC salary breakdown for the employee.

title: post apiattendancecheckin records checkin timestamp
description: Verify that POST /api/attendance/check-in with valid JWT records the check-in timestamp and returns HTTP 200.

title: post apiattendancecheckout records checkout and computes workhours
description: Verify that POST /api/attendance/check-out with valid JWT records the check-out timestamp, computes total work hours, and returns HTTP 200.
